messages:
maria: Quick ping — final RC sweep for v0.23. Cutoff in ~2h. Can folks call out anything blocking? changelog/docs/version bump?

sam: I'm green on infra kit. I'll do the version bump PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3421 :+1:

kevin: Security review: I left one comment on token rotation section in the doc, not blocking but needs to be addressed before prod rollout. @sam can you take a look?

sam: seeing it. will fix and push an amend in ~20m

lily: QA status — smoke passed on staging, flaky test fixed in e2e-helpers. Will run full smoke once the bump is merged. qa-bot will post results.

qa-bot: [automated] smoke-run queued: v0.23-rc1 -> staging (run id 5432)

release-bot: reminder: branch freeze in 1h 30m. Tagging policy: tag `v0.23-rc1` after changelog update.

tara: Docs: need one sentence in release notes about cache-change behavior. small edit here: https://docs.redwood.ai/notes/0.23 -> I can PR if nobody objects.

maria: please go ahead @tara — add the behavior note and a short migration tip. That'll be fine for ship.

kevin: security review re-check: ok after @sam's last push. no further issues from my side. marking approved.

sam: pushed version bump + changelog entries. PR updated.

lily: started full smoke run. Will post failures if any. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

qa-bot: [automated] smoke-run complete: all critical checks passed. Non-blocking flaky: 1 (observability/test-tailer). Details: https://ci.redwood/5432

maria: great. who wants to own the canary plan? I'll do rollout window 09:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow unless someone objects.

tara: I can monitor docs side and support any rollback notes. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll own canary traffic split and metrics. will prepare rollback playbook in the release doc.

maria: OK looks like signoffs: infra/sam, security/kevin, docs/tara, qa/lily. I'm marking this thread as release-ready. I'll tag and cut RC in 30m. :rocket:

lily: quick note — request that observability retention for traces is bumped to 7d for the canary window. small config change, already in PR 3423.

maria: noted. thanks everyone. will post final tag + cut once the merge completes.

release-bot: [automated] branch `main` merged PRs: 3421, 3423. tag `v0.23-rc1` created by @maria

maria: RC cut done. If anything breaks ping this thread and add `release:incident` label. Good job team. :tada:
